criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Card Security
categories.definition: Concerns about card security, including freezing, blocking, or reporting unauthorized use.

categories.name: Money Transfer Issue
categories.definition: Issues related to money transfers, including delays, missing transfers, and refunds.

categories.name: Identity Verification
categories.definition: Questions or concerns about verifying identity for account security.

categories.name: ATM Troubleshooting
categories.definition: Problems or questions related to ATM usage, such as stuck cards or incorrect withdrawals.

categories.name: Payment Issues
categories.definition: Issues with payments, including extra charges, refunds, and declined transactions.

categories.name: Card Activation/Replacement
categories.definition: Questions or requests regarding card activation, replacement, or delivery.

categories.name: Top-Up Queries
categories.definition: Questions about topping up accounts, including methods, fees, and limits.

categories.name: Exchange Rate Inquiries
categories.definition: Inquiries about exchange rates, currency exchanges, and fees.

categories.name: Account Management
categories.definition: Questions related to account details, changes, and restrictions.

categories.name: Virtual Card Assistance
categories.definition: Issues or questions related to virtual cards, including usage, limits, and troubleshooting.
